newsitem.title: UK: London freight - Capers in stronger demand.
newsitem.headline: London freight - Capers in stronger demand.

text.p: The tempo of the dry cargo freight market increased sharply on Thursday with Capers in stronger demand in all areas and higher rates seen from Brazil and Australia.

Modern Panamaxes appeared to be holding their own but brokers were still undecided about the prospects for the older types. The BFI fell 5 points to 1510 with some panellists perceiving marginally easier Atlantic Panamax levels. Handysize rates cotinued relatively soft in the Atlantic (although a good volume of fresh enquiry was quoted) but firmer fixtures were reported in the Far East. As a result the new Baltic Handy Index, published on Tuesdays and Thurdays, advanced from its inaugural 1000 to 1012.

Handy-sizes figured prominently, especially with new business quoted this morning for Atlantic tonnage. Glencore have 10/15,000 SBM pellets prompt Up River/Black Sea, Toepfer 20,000 min/max barley Hamburg/Libya Jan 17/22, Andre 1.2/1.6m cft grain Up River/Cape Town-Beira range, Italgrani 20,000 wheat St Lawrence/Italy Jan/Feb, and Lorico 25/35,000 51/52' US Gulf/Turkey Feb 1/10.

Reports said that Dreyfus had fixed Oldendorff tonnage for 28,000/5 heavy grain prompt Plate/Continent at $19.50 and that Comshipco confirmed World Agamemnon 37,451 dwt delivery Sao Francisco do Sul Jan 20/30 trip Germany at $7,300 daily plus $130,000 bonus (for which the vessel is waiting a week to deliver).

Brokers heard rumoursu that Romac booked an over-age 28,000 dwt vessel delivery spot S Africa for a trip via the Plate to the Continent in the region of only $4,500/4,750 daily. Toepfer were said to hold Handy tonnage firm for Plate/Tunisia at $24.50. Medmar fixed an over-age 22,000 dwt bulker from the Continent spot to the Med at $6,500 daily. In the larger sizes Tradigrain were linked with the 20-year old Da Luo Shan 60,924 dwt delivery spot Flushing trip via ECSA to Turkey at under $9,000 daily. An unnamed grain house was believed to have fixed the Rondeau-relet Banya 73,000 dwt delivery Atlantic for balance of her period timecharter up to September at a solid $11,500 daily.

NSAC booked flavia 65,282 dwt on subjects delivery Baltimore mid Jan for approximately 2-4 months at a firm $11,500 daily plus $220,000 bonus redelivery Continent. Bluedeck quoted a new order of up to Panamax size delivery S W Pass Jan 20/feb 10 trip Egyptian Med.

Atlantic panamaxes believed fixed but not accounted for included Dora Oldendorff 73,974 dwt, Antonis P 77,078 dwt, and Castillo de Almansa 61,418 dwt. In the Pacific Pan Ocean quoted a new enquiry of 34/43,000 dwt Vancouver to Algeria for Jan/Feb, and Bulknova fixed a vessel of 50/60,000 dwt NoPac/Bin Qasim on private terms.

Stronger Caper rates were reported. Krupp paid $8.75 for Angeliki for 100,000/10 ironore Saldanha/Hansaport for Jan/Feb, up a dollar from last fixed, and P and O fixed White Rose for 140,000 coal Gladstone/Fos for mid Feb at close to $9.75. Eptanissa 164,991 dwt spot Gibraltar was still on subjects for unknown business. Other Atlantic Capers believed fixed included the Docenave-relet Tai Shan 149,516 dwt delivery Skaw end Jan trip Far East, SGC capital 179,869 dwt open Antwerp end Jan, and Rhodos by Cetragpa for 100,000 ironore Narvik/Dunkirk East for mid Jan, but full details were lacking.

In the Panamax category Navios were said to have taken Chryssoula l 64,388 dwtn the Med for short period on private terms, and Guinomar fixed the 1977-built Anthi p 63,987 dwt delivery prompt Passero for 3-5 months Atlantic trading at $10,000 daily. Gortys 71,504 dwt fixed and failed with Transfield delivery Continent spot trip via US Gulf to China at $16,250 daily when the fertilizer stem was switched to Black Sea loading. In a relatively quiet Far East market Daicchi were rumoured to have taken Far Eastern Silo 69,338 dwt delivery Kalimantan for 2-4 months and Anton I Angelicoussis 69,346 dwt fixed limestone from japan to taiwan, both on private terms.

Rates for tonnage in the East gained ground. Yukong were said to have booked a 48,000 dwt geared bulker delivery Taiwan for a trip via Australia to S Korea at a little over $9,000 daily. Hanjin fixed a prompt 1977-built 27,500 dwt vessel delivery Port Camphor trip S Korea/Japan at $6,500 daily.

Japanese charterers fixed Jupiter Light 23,700 dwt delivery Japan mid Jan for 3-5 months at $6,150 daily. A Mark-2 Freedom was rumoured fixed from S E Asia for an Australian round at $5,000 daily and a Friendship-type for a trip to the Continent at about $6,000 daily via Australia. On the Continent itself brokers reported more enquiry for tonnage, and also from the Baltic. Iino fixed Sea Crystal 28,269 dwt delivery Hamburg Jan 20/25 trip Far East at $9,750 daily. Kent Line were linked with the Friendship-type Agamemnon 23,443 dwt delivery Atlantic Jan/Feb for 12 months at $7,500 dly.
